name: @arp/hook
description: A runtime hook: records what a session invoked to .arp/session.jsonl and a skill's failures to ~/.arp/failures.jsonl, shows what a skill contains before a skills install, and asks the model for one closing line per skill used, kept on Stop in ~/.arp/outcomes.jsonl.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && bun build src/hook.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming 'arp-[name].js' --target=bun --external viem --external 'viem/*' --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun'
